title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Purchase Option: Buyers, Prices and Quotes
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — buying the leased vehicle under the purchase option**

**Quotes.** A purchase quote can be issued only while the lease status is active or maturity extended.

**Who may buy.** The vehicle may be sold under the purchase option only to the lessee or to a Kestrel franchised dealer that the lessee has authorized through a completed third-party purchase authorization; no other dealer, retailer or third party may buy it.

| Buyer | May buy under the purchase option |
|---|---|
| The lessee | yes |
| A Kestrel franchised dealer, with the lessee's completed third-party purchase authorization | yes |
| A Kestrel franchised dealer without a completed authorization | no |
| Any other dealer, retailer or third party | no |

**Price.** A maturity purchase applies from 90 calendar days before the maturity date through 30 calendar days after it: the price is the purchase option price plus the past-due amount plus the fees due balance. Before that window, and during a maturity extension, the price is the adjusted lease balance plus the purchase option fee plus the past-due amount plus the fees due balance.

| Quote date (hypothetical maturity date December 31) | Price basis |
|---|---|
| October 1 (91 days before) | adjusted lease balance plus purchase option fee, plus past-due amount and fees due |
| October 2 (90 days before) | purchase option price, plus past-due amount and fees due |
| January 30 (30 days after) | purchase option price, plus past-due amount and fees due |
| Any date while the lease is in a maturity extension | adjusted lease balance plus purchase option fee, plus past-due amount and fees due |

**Sales tax and dealer fee.** Sales tax is the price before past-due amounts and fees times the use tax rate percentage, rounded to the cent, and is included in the quote; a Kestrel franchised dealer purchase adds the third-party purchase fee of $300 to the price.

**Validity and completion.** A quote is honoured through 10 calendar days after the quote date. Purchase funds must be certified funds or a dealer remittance, and the purchase completes when the full quoted amount posts, after which the title is transferred and the lease closes. No disposition fee is charged on a purchase.

**Worked illustration (lessee purchase at maturity; all inputs hypothetical)**: purchase option price $22350, past-due amount $0, fees due $25, use tax rate 6 percent. The price is $22350 plus $0 plus $25, that is $22375. Sales tax is $22350 times 6 percent, $1341.00. The quote is $23716.00 and, issued on June 1, is honoured through June 11.
